channel.title: New Straits Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from New Straits Times (nst.com.my)

item.title: Winning days in Malaysian badminton, worrying times for football
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Malaysian badminton is giving the nation reasons to smile. But the same cannot be said about Malaysian football, which is asking the country to wait.

item.title: #SHOWBIZ: 'What did I do wrong?': Ailed M. Jamil distraught over wife's divorce filing
item.description: SUBANG JAYA: Veteran actor and director M. Jamil, who has been battling the effects of a stroke for the past eight years, has expressed his profound distress after his wife filed for divorce.

item.title: PM term limit amendment will not affect King prerogative powers
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: The proposed amendment to the Federal Constitution limiting the prime minister’s term of office will not affect the prerogative powers of the Yang di-Pertuan Agong.

item.title: MPs unite in Dewan Rakyat to condemn US-Israel attacks on Iran
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: An emergency motion tabled by Prime Minister Datuk Seri Anwar Ibrahim condemning Israel and the United States over attacks on Iran received unanimous support from both government and opposition members of parliament in the Dewan Rakyat today.

item.title: Iran war throws oil market into biggest crisis in decades
item.description: GLOBAL energy markets face one of their gravest shocks in decades as joint US and Israeli strikes on Iran and Teheran’s retaliatory missile attacks across the Gulf disrupt oil exports from the world’s most important producing region.

item.title: LRT3 launch expected before June pending final safety approval
#SHOWBIZ: Shila Amzah eyes debt-free future through minimalist shift
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Popular singer Shila Amzah is turning over a new leaf, embracing a simpler lifestyle in a determined bid to unshackle herself from debt.

item.title: OM Holdings completes sale of 26pct stake in NMPL for US$120mil
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: OM Holdings Bhd (OMH) has completed the sale of its wholly owned subsidiary, OMH (Mauritius) Corp’s 26 per cent stake in Ntsimbintle Mining Proprietary Ltd (NMPL) to Exxaro Resources Ltd for approximately US$120 million (US$1=RM3.89).

item.title: STAM seeks Thai expertise to boost women's takraw squad
Suspected drone strike hits British air base in Cyprus
item.description: AKROTIRI: A drone strike hit Britain’s Royal Air Force base of Akrotiri in Cyprus overnight, causing limited damage and no casualties, the island’s president and Britain’s defence ministry said on Monday.
